name: Sagano Romantic Train, Arashiyama, Kyoto
intro: A sightseeing train in Kyoto's Arashiyama area, with one open-air car. Reserved seats go on sale at midnight Japan time, one month before the ride. The busiest times are the autumn leaves in November and cherry blossom in spring.

facts.bookAhead: One month: seats open at 00:00 on the same date a month before

statusNote: Read from the operator's official English FAQ. The rule for dates that don't exist a month earlier is inferred from the official example, since the full rule is shown only as an image.
popularityNote: Not in our keyword data. Estimate: a well-known Arashiyama ride, searched less than the big Tokyo attractions and the Shinkansen.

bookingSteps: Go to the operator's English website and follow "Reserve tickets here" to the online booking system.
Register an account with your email address or a social login.
From 00:00 Japan time, one month before your ride, pick your train and seats on the seat map. You can buy up to 8 tickets at a time.
There are no round-trip tickets. Buy two one-way tickets if you want to ride both ways.
Pay by credit card (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, JCB or Diners Club). The card must support 3D Secure. Debit cards are accepted.
On the day, show the QR e-ticket at the gate.
visitorTips: Window seats are A and D. Car No. 5, "The Rich", is open-air and has no windows.
Cancellation is free until 23:59 the day before you ride, which is also when online booking closes. No refunds on the day.
Dates that don't exist a month earlier: the official example says tickets for March 29 go on sale on March 1. We take this to mean such dates open at 00:00 on the 1st of the travel month.
No card, or no booking? Same-day tickets are sold at Saga station from about 8:35 and Arashiyama station from about 8:50, for cash or IC card (not PiTaPa). None are sold at Hozukyo.
Standing tickets go on sale only after the reserved seats sell out.

faq.q: When do Sagano Romantic Train tickets go on sale?
faq.a: At 00:00 (midnight) Japan time, one month before the boarding date. For example, seats for November 20 go on sale at 00:00 on October 20.

faq.q: Can I buy a round-trip ticket?
faq.a: No. Round-trip tickets are not sold, so buy two one-way tickets.

sources.quote: Tickets can be purchased from 0:00 a.m. (Japan time) one month before the boarding date.
Tickets for boarding on March 29 will be available from 0:00 a.m. on March 1.
